prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / animation asset preparation. Derive a professional 2D animation CUTOUT PARTS ATLAS from ONLY character C (rightmost column) of this reference sheet. Keep its big round one-dot-eye ivory head, very compact body and SHORT limbs, long wraparound paper cloak and two rear folds. User's overriding priority is SOFTNESS: round off torn spikes, gently curved paper edges, few broad flowing folds, subtle low-contrast large-scale paper relief, no rough granular or sharp crystalline texture. This is the same character C in production-ready separated parts, not new designs. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no shadows outside parts, no background, no text, no grid lines. Landscape 1536x1024 requested, six equal invisible cells arranged exactly 3 columns x 2 rows. Every isolated part centered in its own cell with at least 40px empty transparent margins; nothing crosses a cell boundary. All parts for an orthographic right-facing side/three-quarter game sprite, same soft ivory/paper-gray palette and restrained flat painted shading. FULL PARTS including regions that would normally be hidden by overlaps.
TOP LEFT CELL: the complete round ivory head with ONE small dark dot eye near the right side, no mouth/nose, no neck, no hair. Nearly circular silhouette, gentle paper surface shading. Fills about 75 percent of cell height.
TOP MIDDLE CELL: ONLY the front wraparound torso cloak, neck to low hem, WITHOUT head, collar, arms, hands, feet or rear tails. A narrow soft rounded draped tapered shape with diagonal overlapping front paper panels, top neck shoulder area narrow, lower hem softly curved and subtly asymmetrical. Slightly darker warm gray than head. Fills about 75 percent of cell height. No visible bare torso.
TOP RIGHT CELL: ONLY the back cloak tails as ONE connected piece. Attachment at UPPER RIGHT, broad soft flowing shape sweeping DOWN and LEFT, two gently rounded split tail ends at lower left. Length about same as the torso cloak, broad 2-3 paper folds with darker neutral gray inner fold, no spikes. Entire object isolated.
BOTTOM LEFT CELL: ONE very short slim ivory arm with tiny rounded mitten hand. Vertical downward relaxed arm, shoulder root at top and hand at bottom. NO sleeve, no separate glove, no head/body. Fills about 40 percent of cell height.
BOTTOM MIDDLE CELL: ONE short ivory leg and tiny rounded foot pointing right, knee gently bent. Hip root at top, foot bottom. Whole leg+foot one connected part. Fills about 38 percent of cell height. No boot.
BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: ONLY the broad folded paper collar/shoulder mantle from C, a softly curved asymmetrical folded band, with a small neck opening, no torso or head or arms. Width around 65 percent of cell width and height 35 percent of cell. It will layer OVER the front cloak.
Render crisp antialiased high-resolution alpha silhouettes. No ground, no pose figures, no duplicate part in any cell, no labels. Cohesive soft 2D painted-paper game material, not a 3D toy, not pixel art.
